title: uragoga kingiana
intro: Uragoga kingiana, commonly known as the Strychnos nux-vomica, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Uragoga kingiana include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include strychnine and brucine, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
